setup.title: Initial setup
setup.intro_server: No user exists yet. Create the first administrator. The setup code is printed to the console / container log (docker logs).
setup.intro_desktop: No user exists yet. Create the first administrator.
setup.code_hint: One-time code from the log. It expires once the first admin has been created.
setup.done: Administrator created. Please configure Pi-hole and NPM now.
login.title: Sign in
mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
entries.title: Entries
entries.status_other_ip: DNS does not point to NPM
entries.no_target_ip: The NPM IP for DNS records has not been set yet (Settings).
new.title: New entry
new.domain_hint: Fully qualified name, e.g. app.home.lan. Pi-hole will point it to the NPM IP.
new.domain_hint_allowed: Only domains below these are allowed: {list}
new.forward_host_hint: IP or hostname of the service, e.g. 192.168.1.20 or a container name.
new.advanced_warning: Administrators only. Inserted into the nginx configuration without validation. Mistakes can break NPM.
settings.title: Settings
settings.pihole_url_hint: https:// only, e.g. https://pi.hole. The name must match the certificate.
settings.pihole_password_hint: Create it in Pi-hole under Settings → Web interface / API → App password. "webserver.api.app_sudo" must also be enabled to allow changes.
settings.ca_pem_hint_pihole: For self-signed certificates. Pi-hole v6: contents of /etc/pihole/tls_ca.crt.
settings.ca_pem_hint: For self-signed or internal certificates. Empty = system certificates.
settings.npm_url_hint: https:// only. NPM admin interface, e.g. proxied by itself with a valid certificate.
settings.npm_email_hint: Recommended: a dedicated NPM user for this app, without 2FA.
settings.target_ip_hint: All new Pi-hole records point to this IP.
settings.allowed_domains_hint: Comma separated, e.g. "home.lan, lab.lan". Only subdomains of these can be created. Empty = everything allowed (not recommended).
settings.oidc_redirect_hint: This URL must be registered as redirect URI in the identity provider.
settings.oidc_mapping: Only pre-created users can sign in. They are matched by the e-mail address verified by the IdP; afterwards the account is bound to the IdP identity.
users.title: Users
users.email_hint: For OIDC login. Must be unique.
users.password_optional_hint: Leave empty for OIDC-only accounts (e-mail required).
audit.title: Audit log
audit.integrity_ok: Integrity verified: all {n} entries are unmodified.
audit.integrity_broken: WARNING: the audit log has been tampered with (from entry #{id})!
account.title: My account
account.password_changed: Password changed. Other sessions have been signed out.
account.no_password_yet: Your account has no local password yet (OIDC only).
account.totp_intro: Additionally protects your account with a code from an authenticator app (e.g. Aegis, 2FAS, Google Authenticator).
account.totp_scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app and enter the displayed code.
err.session_expired: Session expired, please sign in again.
err.csrf: Security check failed. Please reload the page.
err.rate_limited: Too many failed attempts. Please try again later.
err.account_locked: Account temporarily locked (too many failed attempts).
err.mfa_too_many: Too many wrong codes. Please sign in again.
err.invalid_code: Code is wrong or has already been used.
err.invalid_allowed_domain: Invalid domain in the list of allowed domains.
err.oidc_incomplete: OIDC requires issuer, client ID and redirect URL.
err.invalid_redirect_url: The redirect URL must end with /api/auth/oidc/callback.
err.npm_2fa_enabled: The NPM user has 2FA enabled – please use a dedicated API user without 2FA.
err.oidc_no_user: There is no (active) account for this SSO identity. Please contact an administrator.
err.target_ip_not_configured: The NPM IP for DNS records is not set.
err.advanced_admin_only: Advanced nginx configuration is restricted to administrators.
err.dns_exists: A DNS record for this domain already exists in Pi-hole
err.proxy_exists: A proxy host for this domain already exists in NPM.
err.rollback_failed: NPM error AND the DNS record could not be rolled back – please check Pi-hole manually!
err.email_in_use: This e-mail is already used by another user.
err.cannot_change_self: Your own account cannot be changed this way.
err.last_admin: The last active administrator cannot be removed.
err.setup_incomplete: Setup is not complete yet. Pi-hole and NPM must be configured first.
settings.setup_required: Initial setup: enter the credentials for Pi-hole (URL, password) and NPM (URL, email, password, NPM IP). Saving checks the connection to both; only if that succeeds are the settings stored and the other sections unlocked.
settings.setup_complete: Setup complete – all sections are now available.
pending.title: Not set up yet
pending.text: ProxyDNS Manager is not fully set up yet. Please contact an administrator.
err.settings_check_failed: Checking the settings failed. Nothing was saved – please correct the highlighted values.
nav.setup_mode: Initial setup – other sections unlock after saving.
